title: Chapter 671
text:
Kaboom!

In the distance, the Thousand Beast Soldiers charged toward Han Xiao with large strides. They were like waves approaching, causing the ground to shake violently. Their specially made armor emitted a cold light.

Tamaria raised her hand and threw out a dark gold mechanical axe. The blade of the axe was wrapped in a thick blood-red flame, and it spun at high speed like a red ring of fire, heading straight for Han Xiao's head.

A suffocating wind pressure rushed toward Han Xiao, as though a gust of wind had appeared out of nowhere.

Hu!

Han Xiao stomped on the ground, and a dense spider web of cracks appeared under his feet. Blue flames spurted out from the ground like ripples, pushing him into the sky and avoiding the flying axe's trajectory.

The flying axe suddenly changed its trajectory and flew straight into the sky, chasing after Han Xiao.

Han Xiao looked down from above and saw an alloy chain extending out from the end of the axe handle. It was constantly elongating, and the other end was connected to Tamaria's mechanical suit arm. Clearly, it could be controlled from afar.

The floating monsters behind Han Xiao quickly formed a psionic shield and met the mechanical axe in front of them in the blink of an eye. The two collided heavily!

Dang!

Sparks flew everywhere!

The mechanical axe that was wrapped in red flames was repelled by the shield, and the chain quickly shortened and returned to Tamaria's hand.

This attack opened the curtains of the battle!

Philip gave the alarm, and Han Xiao looked down. The surface defense turrets in the area around the armed satellite fortress all raised their muzzles and fired at him!

Tu tu tu!

The large-caliber cannon barrels spewed out thick smoke, and the mini thermonuclear bombs created a metal wave. The blue, blue, and green plasma cannons followed closely behind, and the laser turrets in the distance shot out beams of high-energy particle beams. All kinds of cannon fire were directed at Han Xiao!

Han Xiao was not only facing five Calamity Grade Supers, but he also had to face the defensive measures of this armed satellite fortress!

The psionic thruster was fully activated, and Han Xiao turned into a blue bolt of lightning, drawing a dazzling flight path in the air and dodging the endless cannon fire.

Rumble —

One after another, violent explosions were left behind by him. The high temperature shockwaves caused the temperature of the mech to rise rapidly.

The sky was soon enshrouded by mushroom clouds one after another, which contained the thunder and lightning of the plasma cannons. It was as if a rapidly expanding thunderstorm cloud had appeared above the satellite fortress!

As for the particle cannon, it pierced through the dark clouds, giving off a myriad of radiance.

If one ignored the dangers involved, this scene was like a thousand rays of light breaking through the clouds. It could be said to be spectacular!

His vision was filled with black smoke, and his Armor Value slowly decreased under the aftermath of the explosion. With a calm expression, Han Xiao activated his Army Box and activated the [Mechanical Force Field] to give him a Mechanical Force bonus.

His energy had a new [Void] attribute, and he could use the Void Dimension to conduct energy from a distance.

This meant that within a certain range, the Mechanical Force bonuses would no longer be limited by space and could be used directly on machines. This greatly reduced the consumption of Mechanical Force bonuses and increased the efficiency of energy transmission.

Crack — —

Dense mechanical sounds suddenly came from the dark clouds, which suppressed the sound of the explosion for a moment. It was like the war drums of a 1.2 million Mech Legion, shaking everyone's hearts!

"Army attack command received. Coverage confirmed, hum …" Philip's cute voice sounded from the mechanical suit's helmet.

The next moment, millions of psionic cannons landed at the same time. It was like a thousand flowers blooming in the night, and stars were falling like rain!

Boom boom boom boom!

The surface of the fortress in this area was instantly plowed. Amidst the blue psionic expansion light, the metal surface was deformed and shattered. Armor parts flew everywhere, and countless large craters were blasted out. It was a scene of devastation.

Forty percent of the defenses in this area were directly destroyed by this round of airstrikes!

The satellite fortress was completely crushed by Han Xiao's army. The black mechanical army descended, causing havoc on the surface, dismantling the cannons of the satellite fortress and fighting with the army of ten thousand beast soldiers.

As far as Han Xiao's eyes could see, the vast battlefield was filled with smoke.

Suddenly, the tactical screen reminded him that there was a high-energy reaction above his head. Han Xiao's eyes narrowed, and he hurriedly dodged to the side.

Hu!

Tamaria's axe brushed past him, creating a strong gust of wind.

A Pugilist's mobility was very high. After her attack missed, Tamaria twisted her body in midair and continuously chopped over. The edge of the axe left behind a blood-red afterimage. Her attacks were like a storm, and before the first wave of attacks had subsided, another wave followed.

The huge force caused the mechanical axe to explode in the air with a deafening sound.

Two shimmering psionic shields popped out of Han Xiao's hands and faced the attack head-on. Sparks flew everywhere, and clanging sounds reverberated like thunder.

Swoosh!

A flood of silver-black nanoparticles gushed out from the tubes on the back of the Mountain Ape mechanical suit and turned into four phantoms that only had their upper bodies. They hovered behind Han Xiao, and eight psionic cannons were aimed at Tamaria, who was fighting with Han Xiao, at the same time.

Bang!

The first round of attacks from the four phantoms did not shake Tamaria's determination to fight in close combat. She used her energy to form a shield on the surface of the axe and blocked the attack!

Bang!

In the second round of attacks, Tamaria still did not move. This kind of attack power was not enough for her to dodge.

In the third round of attacks, Tamaria wanted to block it like before, but she suddenly felt an even stronger force pass through her arm and hit her internal organs.

[Legendary Battle Technique] activated!

The sound of the explosion increased by a notch!

Bang!

Tamaria's expression changed, and she was forced back with a grunt.

"What a strong penetrative force!"

Tamaria suppressed her surging blood and Qi. Her face was filled with bewilderment.

Han Xiao took the opportunity to increase the distance between them. He looked at the combat information, and a look of certainty appeared in his eyes.

Thirty-five percent of the True Damage from the eight Psionic Shock Cannons was more than 12,000 points. Other than the basic Mechanical Force bonus, he did not use any other skills. Just the additional damage from the [Legendary Battle Technique] alone was more than the normal damage from the three attacks after they were reduced by resistances!

"Molding Talents are really scary!" Han Xiao was shocked.

Pugilists were famous for being tanky, and they were perfectly countered by this talent.

Tamaria was a level 230 Pugilist, and her battle style was mainly head-on. Her Endurance should be at least 1,600 points. She was at least an elite Pugilist, and with all kinds of Pugilist talents, her health should be at least above 300,000.

Tamaria's health was more than half of Han Xiao's, but their tankiness was different. Han Xiao relied on the conversion of health to mana, which allowed him to recover twenty-eight percent per second. This kind of recovery speed was enough to make a real tanky Pugilist doubt their life.

"The actual combat effect of this talent is more powerful than I thought. As long as my Mech Army can guarantee a hit rate …"

These calculations took less than a second, and the other four Calamity Grade Supers also followed up and launched their own attacks!

Han Xiao hurriedly dodged all the long-range attacks, but he suddenly felt an attack coming from behind.

One of the opponents was also a Pugilist who specialized in the Critical Strike Penetration Agility Style. He approached Han Xiao from behind like a meteor, and his alloy rapier had a sharp penetrative force. He stabbed toward Han Xiao's head, trying to disrupt his mobility.

Han Xiao did not even turn his head. The four Illusions collapsed and turned back into nanoparticles, reassembling into a mechanical palm that was seven to eight meters in size. Its fingers and palm were covered with a psionic shield, and it grabbed this Pugilist who had ambushed him.

Bang!

The mechanical palm threw him a thousand meters away like trash, and this person smashed into the ground!

Han Xiao experienced the power of his new talent, and he no longer fought with Tamaria's group of five personally. He gave an order, and the Mech Army that was dismantling the satellite fortress immediately split half of its forces to surround the five Calamity Grade Supers.

He himself stayed at the side, interrupting the enemy's attacks from time to time to harass them.

"Do you think you can stop us with these pieces of scrap?"

Tamaria's angry roar reverberated, and the flames on her body surged, breaking through the clouds.

…

At the same time, outside the protective shield of the Hyperdrive Base Station, Morred and the other three Section Zero fleets were fighting with the enemy's defense forces.

They originally had the upper hand, and the enemy's fleets were forced to retreat. However, the other strongholds received a request for reinforcements from the base station, and a portion of the troops from the strongholds broke free from the suppression of Section Zero's troops.

At this moment, the battle was extremely intense.

"Only Black Star managed to board one of the satellite fortresses. How's his situation now?"

In the flagship's main control room, Morred was observing Han Xiao's position through the over-the-horizon module. His vision was covered by the thick fog of the thermonuclear bombs.

Section Zero had sent out many teams to try to board the nine satellite fortresses to destroy the protective shield of the base station. However, the others were all forced to retreat, and only Black Star managed to board one of the satellite fortresses.

Morred's palms were sweating. Their fleets were all blocked by the protective shield, and whether they could destroy the base station as soon as possible depended on whether Black Star could destroy the satellite fortresses as soon as possible.

He was the hope of the entire village!

"Sir, we have observed that Black Star is currently fighting with the defense of the satellite fortresses. The enemy has sent out five Calamity Grade Supers to deal with him. From the looks of it, they seem to be holding Black Star back."

"This is bad." Morred's heart tightened.

At this juncture, if Black Star was held back, the situation would turn into a stalemate. The longer this dragged on, the more disadvantageous it would be for them.

Gritting his teeth, Morred decisively gave the order.

"Inform the other two fleets to gather all the Calamity Grade Supers and reinforce Black Star immediately. He is being held back by the enemy and needs help!"

…
